CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  October 14, 2025

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – September 23, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the September 23, 2025, Regular Meeting of the
  Design Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the September 23, 2025, Regular
  Meeting of the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-058
  • 2708 West Birch Street
  • Applicant: Jenny Zhao
  • Request: This is an application for a new 30-inch-high block wall with
  a stucco finish in the front yard of an existing residential property.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  1
  10/14/2025
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant should coordinate with City staff to complete a
  joint wall agreement form in order to apply a stucco finish to
  the neighboring side of the existing east wall.
  2. If it is determined that the east wall lies within the subject
  property boundaries, then the applicant shall update the
  drawings accordingly to accurately reflect this condition.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-119
  • 441 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: John Jurasic
  • Request: This is an application for the installation of a new
  prefabricated spray booth within an exiting carport, and new exterior
  painting of a 1-story commercial building known as ‘Well Auto
  Collision Center’.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-108
  • 1139 West Main Street
  • Applicant: Richard Rice
  • Request: This is an application for the removal and replacement of
  existing signage, and the installation of one new wall sign on an
  existing 1-story commercial building known as ‘New Century BMW’.

  2
  10/14/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-104
  • 726 East Main Street
  • Applicant: Chae Lee
  • Request: This is an application for new signage on an existing 2-
  story commercial building and one new freestanding sign on the
  northwest corner of the property known as ‘CSC Health Center’.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Signs #3 and #8, as identified in the submitted plan set, shall
  be limited in size, placement, and design characteristics to
  those described in the plans. Any modification, alterations, or
  deviation from the approved signage, including but not limited
  to size, design, material, color or illumination, shall require
  resubmittal for review and approval by the Design Review
  Board prior to installation.
  2. The text currently labeled as “New Tenant Name” on Signs #3
  and #8 shall be revised to avoid the term “tenant”, as the
  building is owned and operated by a single entity and does
  not contain separately leased tenant spaces. Final wording
  shall be submitted for review and approval by city staff.

  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Recused: Ng
  Absent:  Udani
  3
  10/14/2025
 AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-083
  • 1715 Pedley Drive
  • Applicant: Lori Pazula
  • Request: This is an application for the proposed demolition of an
  existing attached structure and covered patio, and the construction of
  a new 898 SF 1-story addition at the rear of an existing 1-story 1,028
  SF single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise the window types on both the existing and proposed
  South Elevation to accurately reflect the casement windows
  currently installed on the building.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 7:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-050
  • 1205 South 4th Street
  • Applicant: Wilson Tan
  • Request: This is an application for a new 974 SF 2-story addition at
  the rear of an existing 1-story 2,018 SF single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Provide a window on the left side of the existing bay window
  to maintain a balanced composition of façade openings along
  the South Elevation.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  4
  10/14/2025
   Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:55 P.M. to
  Tuesday, October 28, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.
